capabilities: Look up Reformed confession and catechism references
Insert Markdown links to source documents
Add custom translation editions from vault notes
disambiguation: Not about the act of confession; it cites historic Reformed confessional documents and catechisms.
extras: AI-assisted development; the author warns that bugs and transcription errors are possible and advises checking wording against the linked source edition before quoting or publishing. The README states it is not yet listed in the Community directory and gives manual install steps.
problem: Citing historic Reformed confessions and catechisms requires looking up exact references and wording, which Obsidian does not provide.
summary: Citation plugin that inserts links or quotations to Reformed confessions and catechisms like the Westminster Standards and Three Forms of Unity.
